meta.title: Recreate with Evaluation Duration 15 Mins
gaps: Verify that the newly created event persists a 15-minute evaluation window after a 30-minute bidding duration.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the newly created event persists a 15-minute evaluation window after a 30-minute bidding duration.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on the buyer-side project summary.
Open the Recreate Order dialog from the event actions.
Verify the recreation dialog includes Product Sheet.
Verify the recreation dialog includes Auction Configurations.
Verify the recreation dialog includes Delivery Date.
Verify the dialog exposes the event scheduling choice.
Verify the end-duration option remains 30 Mins.
Verify that 15 Mins is offered under Evaluation Duration.
Verify the dialog still presents the action to create the recreated order.
Submit the recreation with the selected evaluation duration.
Verify the recreation action completes without an application error.
